test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __buy most__ of my books online.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"I buy most of my books online." **is grammatically** correct.**
 
• The subject **"I" **is correctly followed by the verb **"buy."**
 
• The phrase **"most of my books online"** correctly describes what is being bought and where.
 
• Therefore, **no improvement is needed in the sentence.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I buy most of my books online."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "buys most"** – The verb "buys" is incorrect as it does not agree with the subject "I."
 
• **Option 3: "by most"** – The preposition "by" is incorrect in this context; "buy" is the correct verb.
 
• **Option 4: "buy much"** – "Much" is incorrect as it should be "most" to refer to the quantity of books.
